big_case.notes: The petition raises a consequential First Amendment boundary between government speech and privately delivered instruction required for professional licensure, with implications beyond California medicine. The immediate dispute concerns a particular CME scheme; denial establishes no new nationwide rule.

leakage.notes: Forward mode; prediction formed September 18 against the September 17 as-stored snapshot, before the November 16 denial. Inspected all 37 logged calls (32 captured, five unobserved web calls). The web queries concern Shurtleff and Chiles; their uncaptured results are unknown, not proved empty. Recorded local reads and precedent lookups show no retrieval of this petition's own disposition or later history. No decided-case misprovisioning is evident.
